BiblicalUsage: The hand was sent to write on the wall, and this is the writing that was written: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN. The king was pressed to establish the decree and sign the writing.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the writing on the wall is written by a hand no king can stop, and the signature on the decree is the signature on the king's own judgment.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
